raw_site_text: 20 branches in the regions of Dar es Salaam, Mwanza, Shinyanga, Tabora and Singida; 69 villages in 8 randomly selected branches
justification: The NGO programme operated at 20 branches in the regions of Dar es Salaam, Mwanza, Shinyanga, Tabora and Singida, from which 8 study branches were randomly selected.
note: The 8 study branches are not identified by region, so the exact subset of the 5 regions is not stated.
